lim2026quaternion.summary: Identifies quaternion-Kähler quantum geometry for Kramers pairs, extending ideal-band geometric relations to time-reversal-symmetric multiband states. This provides a possible starting point for exploring correlated phases without breaking time reversal.

kim2024unconventional.summary: Examines topological transitions whose distinguishing features cannot be captured by band-touching trajectories alone.

jung2024quadratic.summary: Connections between wave-function geometry and Landau levels near quadratic band crossings.

lim2023hopf.summary: Establishes the real Hopf insulator in four-band PT-symmetric systems, whose delicate topology depends on both occupied and unoccupied bands.
